description: Official buckets that the Main/Extras inventory registers read-only as cross-bucket dependency sources. They are not part of the compatibility denominator: only Main and Extras Manifests are measured and counted, and these buckets exist so a declared dependency such as versions/python27 resolves exactly as it does for a user who registered the same official bucket. The 40-hex revision below is the fixed input for every measurement and real-root check; changing it changes the dependency evidence.
source_revision_check: git ls-remote https://github.com/ScoopInstaller/Versions HEAD reported 8050ef41c72c2124b864692665ca62d34659b8bc before the bucket was cloned at that revision

buckets.name: versions
buckets.reason: Five Main/Extras packages declare dependencies that live only in the official Versions bucket, so a root without that bucket can only report a missing source.
